title: Pilot onboarding portal in frontend/src/app/ and backend/routers/

invitation_system.security: Secret token (ln_pilot_*) hashed with SHA-256 (token_hash) for storage and lookup, preventing token disclosure through database exposure.
invitation_system.role_guard: Only Admin/Staff can generate pilot invitations (POST /api/v1/pilot/invitations). Regular learners/guests receive HTTP 403.
invitation_system.quotas: Enforces max_uses per invitation and auto-transitions status to 'exhausted' upon full redemption.
invitation_system.expiration: Configurable expiration timestamp (expires_at) blocking expired invitations from redemption.

guided_activation.compliance_gate: Requires explicit confirmation (compliance_accepted=True) of pilot research ethics and student data privacy (Decree 13/2023/ND-CP).
guided_activation.role_promotion: Automatically sets user.is_school_verified=True and upgrades role to UserRole.teacher for school_teacher invitations.
guided_activation.step_progression: Interactive checklist tracking completion across 7 structured onboarding milestones (welcome, curriculum alignment, lesson wizard, printable kit, roster setup, rubric practice, and completion).

usage_health_telemetry.health_scoring: Dynamic health score (0-100) calculated from participant login count and meaningful telemetry interaction actions.
usage_health_telemetry.risk_status: Automatically flags status as 'healthy' or 'attention_needed' to enable proactive pedagogical and technical interventions.

support_workflow.ticket_codes: Generates unique human-readable ticket codes (PILOT-REQ-XXXX) with priority and category classifications.
support_workflow.tenant_isolation: Participants can only access their own support tickets; staff can view and reply to all active pilot tickets.

negative_abuse_invariants.unauthorized_access: User without invitation token or with forged/invalid token CANNOT join private school/partner trial (HTTP 403).
negative_abuse_invariants.revoked_or_expired: User attempting to activate revoked, expired, or exhausted token is strictly rejected (HTTP 403).
negative_abuse_invariants.unactivated_action_gate: Non-activated user attempting to record onboarding steps or fetch pilot health receives HTTP 404.
negative_abuse_invariants.non_staff_invitation_generation: Learners or non-staff attempting to generate invitations receive HTTP 403.

endpoints.description: Staff generates a secure pilot invitation token
Validate pilot invitation token status before redemption
Authenticated user redeems invitation token and activates pilot trial
Retrieve current user's active pilot trial and onboarding checklist progress
Record completion of a guided activation checklist step
Retrieve usage health, engagement telemetry, and score for current pilot user
Log an interaction action to update pilot usage health score
Create a pilot feedback or support ticket
List pilot support tickets (scoped to user, or all for staff)
Add threaded response to a pilot support ticket

features: Token validation interface with instant validity check and organization preview
Mandatory ethics and student data compliance agreement toggle
Multi-tab pilot dashboard: Checklist Progression, Usage Health Telemetry, and Support Center
Dynamic step completion reporting with visual checklist badges
